data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provisions for claims includes a deterioration of GBP 3.4m in respect of reserves set in prior years (2021: deterioration of GBP 8.2m).

named_events.loss_description: The current ultimate estimated losses for Hurricane Ian are gross and net $48.5m.

Hurricane Ida which struck Louisiana in August 2021, causing $35bn-$40bn of insured loss. For Ida, we are projecting ultimate gross losses of $37.3m, (last year $39.2m) of which $33.7m had been incurred at year end (last year $29.4m).
for those Uri policies that fall to the 2021 year, we are projecting $4.5m (last year $4.2m), of which $4.1m had been incurred at year end (last year $3.65m).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of GBP 3.313m for the 2020 underwriting year, derived from the claims development triangle. The report also noted a net deterioration of GBP 3.4m in respect of reserves set in prior years. This adverse development is primarily attributed to an increase in claims estimates. Specific prior year events mentioned as affecting the 2021 year of account include Hurricane Ida and Uri policies.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of GBP 3.4m in respect of reserves set in prior years
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is calculated from the gross claims development triangle for the 2020 underwriting year, as no explicit gross prior year movement figure was stated in narrative or notes. The report does state a net deterioration of GBP 3.4m for prior years. Gross premium mix is based on the segmental analysis which states all business is 'reinsurance accepted' and primarily US property catastrophe risks.
